text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion!
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi, reporting in!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Aiming to become a Triple Crown Umamusume just like the President,
I'll dash at full power—*cough, hack, wheeze*!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*cough*... I'm fine!
I just got a little too pumped up, that's all!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
